title.en: Graph of Stopping Potential vs Frequency
title.hi: निरोधी विभव बनाम आवृत्ति का ग्राफ

description.en: Graph showing the linear variation of stopping potential with frequency of incident light for two different metals.
description.hi: दो अलग-अलग धातुओं के लिए आपतित प्रकाश की आवृत्ति के साथ निरोधी विभव के रैखिक परिवर्तन को दर्शाने वाला ग्राफ।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <g transform="translate(50, 250)">
    <!-- Axes -->
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="400" y2="0" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="380" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Frequency (ν)</text>
    
    <line x1="0" y1="50" x2="0" y2="-200" stroke="#111827" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="-45" y="-210" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Stopping</text>
    <text x="-45" y="-195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">Potential (V0)</text>

    <!-- Metal A line -->
    <line x1="80" y1="0" x2="250" y2="-170" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="80" y1="0" x2="40" y2="40" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="260" y="-160" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">Metal A</text>
    
    <!-- Metal A Threshold Freq -->
    <circle cx="80" cy="0" r="4" fill="#111827" />
    <text x="70" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">ν0A</text>

    <!-- Metal B line -->
    <line x1="160" y1="0" x2="330" y2="-170" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="3" />
    <line x1="160" y1="0" x2="120" y2="40" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="340" y="-160" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#3b82f6">Metal B</text>

    <!-- Metal B Threshold Freq -->
    <circle cx="160" cy="0" r="4" fill="#111827" />
    <text x="150" y="20" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold">ν0B</text>

    <!-- Note about slope -->
    <path d="M 140 -60 Q 200 -30 230 -60" fill="none" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />
    <text x="160" y="-70" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Slope = h/e</text>
    <text x="160" y="-50" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280">(Same for all metals)</text>
  </g>
</svg>
